anchor: anchor = ROM sprite origin inside the canvas; draw with centered=false and offset = (-anchor[0], -anchor[1])
flipping: players/enemies sheets have been mirrored in-project (stored facing RIGHT, tools/flip_facing.gd, 2026-11-06); runtime flips when facing left; other categories keep native ROM orientation
palette: all sheets use ROM palette page 0-0 (stage 1 / scene 1); enemies need per-stage recolour
sheet: one PNG per animation segment; frames laid out left-to-right, top-to-bottom, gapless, 8 columns per row
slice: frame i -> rect (i %% cols * w, i // cols * h, w, h)
